decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf builds directly on the firm's core baking knowledge, so management can read its sales and refine it in-house, which makes keeping it low-risk.

The mill tour uses the firm's heritage and event facilities, but pandemic-era disruption to hospitality and less familiar demand signals raise some risk, though the firm can still assimilate the lessons and keep it.
The crusty farmhouse bread sits squarely within the firm's established craft knowledge and recipes, so it is easy to interpret and adjust without outside research.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen is a flagship that draws on the firm's traditional recipes, and the external recognition gives clear evidence the firm can build on.
The gold-awarded premium stollen leverages core seasonal confectionery expertise and has validated quality, so it fits the firm's knowledge base well.
